title: Xanadu Next
statusNote: Plays: N-Gage logo, rating screen, title menu, Start Game > New loads the town of Harlan Berck; after the priest's opening talk (choosing a guardian and raising an ability) the character walks around the town and attacks, and the status and pause menus open.
notes: A title menu left alone for about half a minute plays a story demo and then returns.
On the title menu the right soft key is QUIT. Quitting ends the game and leaves a black screen; reload the page to start again.
On the ability screen at the start, OK raises the selected ability; the screen closes once the bonus is spent (raise a second ability with down, then OK).
Keys 1 and 3 open the status menu (Status, Guard, Item, Magic, Skill) and step through its tabs; 5 selects in it and 7 closes it.
Either soft key opens the pause menu (Resume, Return to Main Menu, Audio, Exit Game).

The game has no two-player game in its menus. Its Bluetooth (Options > Bluetooth shows the switch and the device's name) appears to be for trading cards with another player. That could not be tried: Cards on the title menu says "No Cards" and the priest's Consult card says you have none until a card is found in the game. N-Gage Arena is no longer online.

multiplayer.statusNote: No hosting or joining was reached. The title menu (Start Game, Continue, Cards, Options, N-Gage Arena) and the game's pause and status menus have no two-player game; Options > Bluetooth shows On and the name in the room. Cards says "No Cards" in a new game, so the card trade the program has over Bluetooth could not be started.

controls.source: The game's own Options > Controls screen (its defaults: Attack 5, Magic 7, Equip (L) 1, Equip (R) 3). Moving, attacking, the status menu and its keys, the pause menu and OK for dialogue were tried in play.

actions.rsk: Pause menu; cancel in menus; quit on the title menu
actions.1: Equip (L): open the status menu, previous tab
actions.3: Equip (R): open the status menu, next tab
actions.5: Attack; select in the status menu

notes: Options > Controls can move Attack, Magic and the two Equip actions to other number keys.
